Free Nursery and Welfare Complex: (Incorporation) Act, No. 31 of 2009
to assist children and adults by providing necessary
schools  and  educational  institutes  other  than
national schools enumerated  in Appendix III of List
1  of  the  9th  Schedule  to  the  Constitution,  with
accessory, educational and library facilities ;
to  provide  necessary  financial  assistance  for  the
promotion of arts, literature, construction of images
and    modelling,  production  of  television  Dramas,
films and stage plays, in order to develop the interest
and skills of members and non members ;
to organize national and religious ceremonies and
“Sramadanas”,  for  the  development  of  mutual
confidence and goodwill among the people ;
to  develop  ational  and  international  relationships
by exchanging experience and technical knowledge
and to organize excursions ;
to collect economical and human resources for the
purpose  of  investigation  and  accumulation  of
information ;
to care for disabled persons and to provide homes
for the aged ;
to protect the environment and to improve modern
techniques of organic agriculture ; and
to  print,  publish  and  distribute  books,  journals,
leaflets,  newspapers  and  magazines  which  the
Corporation  may  consider  desirable  for  the
promotion and advancement of its objects.
